summary: FastAPI + React + Tailwind monochromatic minimalist UI on top of the existing CLI.

stories.title: Project scaffolding
acceptanceCriteria: webui/backend/ and webui/frontend/ directories exist
.gitignore excludes node_modules, dist, .pytest_cache, *.egg-info
requirements-dev.txt lists fastapi, uvicorn[standard], python-multipart, sse-starlette, httpx, pytest-asyncio
webui/frontend has a Vite React+TS scaffold with package.json and vite.config.ts
Tailwind installed and configured with a zinc-based monochrome theme

stories.title: Backend foundation: app, job registry, schemas
acceptanceCriteria: webui/backend/app.py exposes a FastAPI instance importable as webui.backend.app:app
webui/backend/jobs.py defines an in-memory JobRegistry with status (queued|running|paused|done|failed|cancelled)
webui/backend/schemas.py defines Pydantic models for UploadResponse, JobStatus, Settings, ChapterPreview
Backend imports without error in the project's .venv
GET /api/health returns {status: 'ok'}

stories.title: Upload + naming-preview + job-status endpoints
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/upload accepts an EPUB via multipart and returns {job_id, title, author}
GET /api/jobs/{id}/naming-preview returns 4 columns (toc, heading, class, fallback) for at least 1 sample chapter
POST /api/jobs/{id}/naming accepts {method} and writes the .txt with the chosen naming
GET /api/jobs/{id} returns current JobStatus snapshot

stories.title: Conversion run + SSE progress stream
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/jobs/{id}/start launches the TTS conversion as a subprocess
GET /api/jobs/{id}/events streams SSE events (chapter / paragraph / sentence / elapsed / eta)
Progress events parse from the existing logger output
POST /api/jobs/{id}/cancel terminates the subprocess and preserves partN.flac

stories.title: Inline .txt editor endpoints
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/jobs/{id}/text returns {title, author, chapters: [{title, paragraphs}]}
PUT /api/jobs/{id}/text accepts the same shape and serializes back to the .txt format
Round-trip via get_book(...) preserves title, author, and chapter titles

stories.title: Frontend foundation: layout, API client, monochrome theme
acceptanceCriteria: App boots via `npm run dev` on localhost:5173
Tailwind compiles a zinc-950 background with zinc-100 text and 1px zinc-800 borders
src/api.ts exports typed wrappers for upload, jobs, naming, text, and an SSE helper
App shell shows header + footer + main slot in a max-w-3xl content column

stories.title: Tier 1 UI: upload card + naming preview table
acceptanceCriteria: <UploadCard> uses an <input type='file' accept='.epub'> hidden behind a styled label
Selecting a file POSTs /api/upload and transitions to the naming preview view
<NamingPreview> renders the 4 methods as clickable column headers; selected column is visually highlighted
Clicking 'Continue' POSTs /api/jobs/{id}/naming with the selected method

stories.title: Tier 1 UI: live progress + chapter editor
acceptanceCriteria: <JobProgress> subscribes to SSE and renders chapter index, paragraph index, elapsed, ETA, throughput, and a thin progress bar
<ChapterEditor> renders a sidebar of chapters and a main pane with title + paragraph textareas
'Save & Convert' PUTs the file then POSTs /api/jobs/{id}/start
Adding/removing/reordering chapters works without page reload

stories.title: Tier 2: voice samples + settings panel + resume detection + cancel
acceptanceCriteria: <SampleBrowser> uploads .wav files and previews them via <audio controls>
<SettingsPanel> form persists settings to localStorage and forwards them as CLI flags
/api/jobs/{id}/resume-state returns {completed_chapters, total_chapters, completed_titles}
Cancel button terminates the job and partN.flac files remain on disk for resume

stories.title: Tier 3: library + per-chapter preview + re-render
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/library returns one entry per .m4b file with title, author, cover URL
<Library> grid renders cards with cover image
Per-chapter play button streams the corresponding partN.flac
Per-chapter 're-render' POSTs /api/jobs/{id}/chapter/{n}/rerun and the chapter regenerates

stories.title: Quality gate: tests, build, regression
acceptanceCriteria: pytest tests/ + pytest webui/backend/tests both pass
npm run build produces a dist/ bundle without errors
Existing 49 unit tests still pass (no regression)
README updated with web UI quickstart
